name: require-project-context-double-identity
body: The binding resolves the repo identity twice, once in the guard and once inside require_project, keeps the pre-registry membership_refusal shape until task 7 upgrades it, and adds no unit test at this tier because the binding is e2e-covered; fold the two identity walks into one if the guard becomes hot, and let task 7 own the registry-aware wording.
